tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog gi phrin las la nye bar mkho ba'i rol tshigs rnams kyi ring thung sogs kyi tho chung dran pa 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kyi// bka' don ma lus sems can mos pa bzhin// legs par 'doms mdzad dpaṃl gyi 'byung gnas che// mkhas btsun bzaṃng po de yis rtag tu skyongs// gang de'i zhal gyi pad+ma phye ba las// nye bar 'phos pa'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i rgyun// bdag blo'i bung ba gzhon nus 'thungs pa'i ro// rjes su dran pa'i tho chung dbyangs su len// de la 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog gi phrin las nyams su bstar ba la nye bar mkho ba'i rol tshigs rnams kyi ring thung la sogs pa ji ltar bya ba'i khyad par rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len du ji ltar srid pa/ bdag cag gis rje btsun bla ma sku drin mtshungs pa med pa de nyid las yongs su mnyan pa rnams dran 'dzin gyi yi ger 'god pa ni 'di ltar te/ rol tshigs so so'i rnam grangs ni gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir de dag gi ring thung la sogs pa'i dbye ba brjod pa la/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs kyi rol mo la/ ma he dang rkang gling 'bud cing rag dung lhu gcig song ba dang*/ rol mo gsor la thag brdeg lnga re yod pa'i chung ngu lnga'am bdun gyis bsgrigs nas/ de dang 'dra ba'i chen po gsum gyis bcas/ chung ngu gsum gyis bcas te/ 'di dag la zhi drag cha zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dogs so// cha gnyis pa la thag bzhi/ cha gsum pa la thag gsum/ cha bzhi pa la thag gnyis/ cha lnga pa la thag gcig cha drug pa la thag tshem tshem/ cha bdun pa nas shin tu tshem tshem/ de nas drud dang*/ de nas drud kyang spangs

skabs 'dir ma he dang rkang gling 'bud/ pa cha gsum gyi mtha' nas drag po'i gyis zhes pa dor ba'i tshab tu drud tsam re dang bcas te rim gyis phab nas/ slar yang dal bus 'phar ba cha gsum gyi mthar drag po cung zad ring ba gsum gyi rjes ma bskor tsam gyi rjes su/ drag po myur ba gsum dang*/ drag po ring tsam gnyis la cha rer byas pa'i 'phar 'bebs snga ma bzhin byas nas/ slar yang dal bus 'phar ba cha gsum gyi mthar gnyis pa bskor te gcig gis bcad/ de nas sum brdeg drag po kho na'i 'gros kyis 'phar 'bebs snga ma bzhin byas pa'i mthar thag brdeg dang bcas pa'i drag po gcig gis bcad do// de la khugs pa gcig ces bya'o/ ༈ /slar yang thag gsum yod pa'i chung ngu bzhis bsgrigs nas/ thag gsum pa'i drag po gsum dang zhi ba gsum char byas nas rje thung du btang ba cha gsum/ thag gnyis pa cha gcig thag pa gcig pa cha gcig sogs man chad snga ma ltar khug pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar bcad do/ ༈ /slar yang de 'dra ba khug pa yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gi mtha' ma la/ drag po sum brdeg can lan gsum gyi bar du 'phar ba'i 'phar gnyis pa de'i nang nas ma he rkang gling 'bud cing*/ 'phar gsum pa rdzogs pa'i mthar thag brdeg dang bcas pa'i drag po gnyis kyis bzhag go /khug pa phyi ma 'di ni 'og gi byin 'bebs rgyas pa kun la sbyar bar bya'o// khyad par ni spyan 'dren gyi byin 'bebs rgyas pa dang thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rol tshigs la thag brdeg yod/ mjug gi byin 'bebs drud nas brtsams te drag po gcig gis bcad pa'i bar gong dang 'dra'o// mchod pa'i mgor spyan 'dren las thag thung ba'i byin 'bebs la rol tshigs thag med bya zhing mchod sngags rnams ni tshem brdung gi bar la 'don pa'i mthar drag po gcig gis bcad do// mchod rol gyi mtha'i bstod pa mi thung sgeg po la gong du bshad pa'i drud nas brtsams te byin 'bebs yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig bya ste/

'go mjug gi byin 'bebs thag med smos pa thams cad la 'dis 'gre'o// de nas 'go'i rol tshigs dang dbyangs kyi mthar thag yod/ gdangs kyi mthar thag med byas la 'jam dbyangs khros pa'i byin 'bebs kyi rol mo sbrel te/ de'i rol tshigs thag med la mthar byin 'bebs kyis bcad do/ ༈ /phyogs skyong la thag chen bcas pa'i byin 'bebs bya/ rol tshigs 'theng rkang gnyis la thag yod dang*/ dgu brdeg dang 'theng rkang la thag med byas te des 'gre'o// gdangs kyi mthar thag med la sogs pa gzhan 'gre'o/ ༈ /las gshin gyi spyan 'dren la'ang thag chen dang bcas pa'i byin 'bebs rgyas pa gong bzhin dang*/ rol tshigs dbyangs kyi mthar thag yod dang gdangs kyi mthar thag med bya ba la sogs pa 'dra'o// mchod pa'i 'gor thag med lngas bsgrigs la drud nas 'go brtsams pa'i byin 'bebs snga ma dang 'dra zhing rol tshigs/ mchod sngags rnams la tshem brdung byed pa sogs gong bzhin no// lho yi phyogs rol rjes ma la yang byin 'bebs de dang 'dra zhing dbyangs la thag yod dang gdangs la thag med byin 'bebs la sogs pa 'dra'o/ ༈ /las gtad kyi 'gor thag brdeg dang bcas pa'i byin 'bebs dang*/ rol tshigs sum brdeg lan bcas la thag yod dang*/ dgu brdeg nas brtsams te de man chad kun la thag med dang mtha'i byin 'bebs bcad mtshams yan chad gzhan dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /nyi ma rjes ma'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ liṅga 'gugs 'dren gyi byin 'bebs thag med kyi mthar chung ngu gcig gis bcad la/ rol tshigs thag med dkyus ltar bya/ de nas dgug gzhug lan gsum gyi dang po gnyis kyi mthar drag rol je myur la btang ba'i mthar drag po res bcad/ gsum pa'i mtha'i drag rol de nyid khug pa gsum du byas pa'i mthar zhe sdang gis mnan gyi rol tshigs thag med len/ dbyangs kyi mtha' la'ang thag med blangs la/ rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshig rkang gcig po de man chad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar la tshig brdung zhi drag bya zhing thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar rol tshigs la byin 'bebs sbrel ba'i mthar bcad/

'jam dbyangs khros pa'i byin 'bebs thag med len pa ma gtogs 'dra'o/ ༈ /phyogs skyong gi gtor ma bsngo ba'i bstod pa dang 'dod gsol la mchod rol bya/ thams cad kyi rjes ma la mchod rol spangs te bskul ba'i byin 'bebs kyis thus so// phyi rol tu 'gro ba'i grabs 'grigs nas/ chung ngu lngas bsgrigs la sum brdeg len bcas la slob dpon gyis rtse gsum 'gros kyis gtor ma'i rtsar phyin la gtor ma btegs la bskur/ de nas rim gyis gral bsgrigs te sum brdeg zhi drag gis phyi rol du 'gro zhing der slob dpon gtor ma'i rtsar phyin nas gral 'grigs pa dang*/ byin 'bebs thag med blangs pa'i mthar/ rgya mtsho gting rum gyi rol tshigs thag med bya/ de rdzogs pa'i mthar byin 'bebs thag med dang zor lam gyi rol tshigs rnams kyang thag med blangs/ rdzogs pa'i mthar byin 'bebs kyi sngon du zhi drag sum brdeg dang bstun nas slob dpon gyis rtse gsum 'gros kyis gtor ma'i rtsar byon te gtor ma bteg byin 'bebs rdzogs pa na gral bshig la rim gyis 'gro/ slob dpon yang sngar gyi gral mthud de 'byon/ gtor lam yod par gral bsgrigs nas las gtad kyi byin 'bebs 'dra'o// mthar sum brdeg zhi drag dang bstun la snga ma bzhin du slob dpon rtse gsum 'gros kyis gtor ma'i rtsar byon la byin 'bebs kyi rol mo'i skabs der phud mchod rdzogs par byas la/ ar+ghaṃ dang mna' chu sbreng ba la sogs pa kun gyis ma tshor bar shub bus brjod/ de dag grub pa dang gtor ma bteg la g.yas g.yon mdun gsum du gsor ba dang bstun la/ rol mo sum brdeg zhi drag bya zhing rkang pas rtse gsum bri ba'i tshul yang byas la yun du gsor nas brgyab pa'i bar la yang drag rol yun ring du bya/ de nas drug cu pa bteg ste ma gsor gyi bar du drag rol byas la/ slar snga ma bzhin brgyab pa dang bstun pa'i rol mo byas te/

sum brdeg drag pos bcad pa'i mthar rkang pa g.yon pa nang du 'jog ste phyi mig mi lta bar dpon slob thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi don bzhin pa'i ngang nas nang du ldog la rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// spyir 'di dag la 'og nas rol tshigs zhi ba 'byung na byin 'bebs kyi mtha' drag po gcig gis bcad/ drag po 'byung na zhi bas bcad pa dang*/ dbyangs dang gdangs ring rnams kyi 'gor thag thag gis bzhag gdangs thung rnams kyi 'gor drud kyis bzhag pa sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'don pa ring thung dang bstun pa dang*/ bcad mtha' thams cad rbad kyis bzhag pa la sogs pa'i rnam par dbye ba thams cad la shin tu mkhas par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ rngam brjid sgeg pa'i nyams dang 'gyur khugs kyi// 'degs 'jog tshul la mkhas pa'i rol mo yis// rgyal ba mchod cing phrin las bskul ba'i thabs// gang gis shes de gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyan// 'on te bslab dang sbyangs pa'i rgya mtsho las// mngon 'dod rig pa'i nor bu ma blangs par// shes rlom dregs pa'i gor ma rab bcangs nas// mang po'i mgo 'phang smad pa gad mo'i rgyu// de skad bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ngor// dbang rtul rig pa phreng du bstar ba yi// dge bas rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan mdzod// snyan pa'i rol mos rjod pa bdag gyur cig /de ltar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog gi phrin las la nye bar mkho ba'i rol tshigs rnams kyi ring thung la sogs pa'i lag len gyi tho chung dran pa 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbang rtul rig pa'i 'gros su btang bas blo dang ldan pa dag ni mgu ba'i re ba shin tu phra na yang*/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i gsar bu sbyangs pa chung zhing the tshom gyi 'phrang du 'grims pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag ste/ rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang ba'i gsung sgros kyi me tog gtsug rgyan du bcings nas ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/

// ༄༅// ngor lugs bskang gso che chung gi rol tshigs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi zhal shes kyi tho yig dran gso'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī gho ṣā ya/ 'dir ngor lugs bskang gso che chung gi rol tshigs rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams kyi zhal shes rnams mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa las ji ltar thos pa rnams thor 'god pa la/ thog mar byin dbab spyi la chung ngu dal po lngas bsgrigs/ de lta bu'i che ba rnams rje myur btang nas rim gyis phab pa'i mthar drag po gsum gyis mtshams bcad dang sprel ba'i chem brdung je chung btang ba'i mthar mtshams gcod gong ltar byas pa de 'dra ba gsum gyi mthar shin tu zhi bar btang ngo*// de nas dam rdzas mar mtshams bcad chung ngu gcig gi rjes thogs 'theng rkang gnyis dang sum brdeg gis bcas mthar 'theng rkang gcig go /de nas dbyangs ring dzar brdeg bcas pa lag len ltar/ tshar dang po thams cad dbyangs bya/ mthar rol tshigs kyi rjes su byin dbab sngar bzhin gyi mthar bzlog pa byed na sum brdeg drag la ring ba gyis bcas de nas dgu brdeg myur ba gyis bcas dang sum brdeg ring ba gcig go /do nub bzlog sogs la rnga tshigs dang bstun pa'i tshig brdung rol tshigs sngar bzhin/ zung ching zhes pa'i tshig gcig de la tshem brdung mthar yang tshig brdung rnga tshigs bcas pa'i rjes byin 'bebs lhu thung gi mthar sum brdeg lan bcas kyis mtshams bcad pa ni shin tu rgyas pa'o// bzlog pa mi byed na byin 'bebs mthar sum brdeg lan bcas bya'o// gnyis pa 'bring bsdus gsum las shin tu bsdus pa kha'u ma la chung ngu gsum gyis bsgrigs la 'theng gnyis/ lnga brdeg gcig 'theng gcig kha'u ma gdangs bya/ yum chen g.yung mo nas tshig rkang re re bzhin zhi drag rnga tshigs dang bstun pa'i sh+lau ka gcig la tshig brdung*/ sde tshan re re bzhin gyi mthar rol tshigs re re/

gdong bzhi dregs pa'i 'gor rol mo mi dgos/ mthar bzlog pa mi byed na rol tshigs kyis bzhag bzlog pa byed na 'bring bsdus kun la byin 'bebs lhu thung gi mthar bcad mtshams med pa'i sum brdeg drag la ring ba gyis bcas sogs snga ma bzhin bya'o// gsum pa 'bring po'i rgyas pa la chung ngu gsum gyis bsgrigs rnga tshigs rgyas pa dang 'dra/ dbyangs rgyas pa'i rnga tshigs kyi mthar lha mchog ma hā kā la man gdangs 'don mthar rol mo med/ rak+ta dmar chen dam rdzas rgyan ldan/ gdong bzhi dregs pa rnams dbyangs bya/ lha mchog ma sogs thams cad gdangs bya/ mthar bzlog pa sogs gnyis pa bzhin no// bzlog pa mi 'don na rang rang rnga tshigs kyis mtshams bcad do// bzhi pa kha'u ma/ lnga pa 'bring po'i bsdus pa ni/ 'bring rgyas dang 'dra ba las/ lha mchog ma sogs kun la dbyangs bya ba la nyams chag gsos gyur cig ces pa'i bar rol tshigs mi bya/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// drug pa kha'u ma/ bdun pa gsum pa dang 'dra/ brgyad pa kha'u ma/ dgu pa lnga pa dang 'dra/ bcu pa kha'u ma/ bcu gcig las mi byed na gong gi rgyas pa dang 'dra'o// tshar grangs mang nyung gang byas kyang 'bring po rgyas bsdus gnyis kha'u ma dang sbags te btang ba'o// byin 'bebs ni 'go mtha' gnyis ma gtogs gzhan la med do// he ru ka la byin 'bebs gong dang 'dra bar byas la drag po gyis bcas kyis mtshams bcad pa'i rjes der rnga tshigs sum brdeg lan bcas ring po bya/ dbyangs sku gsung thugs sogs sh+lau ka gnyis re dbyangs byas pa mtshams su rnga tshigs dang*/ de las gzhan yang man chad sh+lau ka re'i dbyangs mthar rnga tshigs bya/ mthar byin 'bebs snga ma bzhin gyi rjes la sum brdeg lan bcas kyis mtshams bcad nas 'theng rkang gnyis dang sum brdeg lan bcas dgu brdeg gcig dang sum brdeg gcig drag po che ba gcig de lta bu'i bzlog dbyangs sh+lau ka bzhi dang bcas la rnga tshigs snga ma bzhin dang de la sogs te gdug sems man chad la tshem brdung rnga tshigs dang bstun pa'i zhi drag tshig rkang re re bzhin bya/

sod cig thul cig man nas thams cad drag po rjes rnga tshigs sogs 'dra/ mthar drag rol med par bzlog rol dngos kyis mtshams bcad pa ni rgyas pa'o// gnyis pa chung ngu bzhis bsgrigs la rnga tshigs bya/ thog mar sh+lau ka gnyis dbyangs bya/ de nas phrin las lhun grub kyi bar rnga tshigs med par gshar gdangs bya/ rjes byin 'bebs lhu thung gi mthar mtshams bcad med pa'i sum brdeg drag po gsum gyis bcas dgu brdeg gcig sum brdeg drag la ring ba gsum sogs bzlog rol gong dam rdzas ma'i skabs ltar dang*/ do nub bzlog bsgyur la tshem brdung gi mthar rnga tshigs bya/ rtag tu srung skyob kyi mthar tshigs brdung rjes rnga tshigs dang drag rol gyi mthar sum brdeg lan bcas kyis mtshams bcad pa ni bsdus pa'o// gsum pa 'bring po ni gong dang 'dra ba las khyad par sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams la sh+lau ka re dbyangs rjes rnga tshigs bya/ de las gzhan dang sprul pa'i khyung chen gnyis sh+lau ka re re dbyangs byed pa'i srol yod med lugs gnyis yin/ gtor ma gsol sogs nges par dbyangs bya ste/ 'di rnams kyi dbyangs kyi 'go la rol mo med/ rjes byin 'bebs lhu thung bzlog rol rgyas pa sh+lau ka gsum dbyangs ma gtogs rgyas pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba ni 'bring po'o// bzhi pa gnyis pa dang 'dra/ lnga pa gsum pa dang 'dra ba las sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gtor ma gsol shing rnams la dbyangs bya/ dbyangs kyi 'go la rol mo med pa sogs thams cad snga ma ltar dang*/ bzlog pa sh+lau ka gcig dbyangs bya ba ni 'bring po'i bsdus pa'o// drug pa bsdus pa dang 'dra/ bdun pa 'bring po ste gsum pa dang 'dra/ brgyad pa bsdus pa dang 'dra/ dgu pa lnga pa dang mtshungs/ bcu pa bsdus pa dang 'dra'o// tshar bcu gcig las mi byed na byin 'bebs bcas mtha' ma 'di rgyas pa ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// gzhan 'bring bsdus thams cad la byin 'bebs mi dgos so// de nas bstod gsar la bzlog rol gyis mtha'i drag chen 'gying nas gyis bcas mthar/

bdun brdeg ring ba gcig sum brdeg lan bcas gcig sngags dbyangs mthar rnga tshigs sum brdeg lan bcas dbyangs byed na dzar brdeg bcas pa'i sum brdeg lan bcas/ mgon po'i bstab pa'i mthar nyis brdeg lan bcas bya/ gnyis pa lha mo'i bstod pa la nyis brdeg lan bcas bstab pa la sum brdeg lan bcas 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i mthar/ gsum pa gdong bzhi pa la bdun brdeg gcig nyis brdeg lan bcas/ sngags dbyangs mthar nyis brdeg lan bcas sogs 'dra/ bstab pa la khyed mthun ma ltar mthar 'theng rkang 'gying bcas kyi rjes/ bzhi pa las mgon bstod gsar la dgu brdeg 'theng rkang gnyis lnga brdeg 'theng gcig sngags dbyangs mthar dgu brdeg spangs pa'i rnga tshigs 'theng rkang man chad bya ste/ dbyangs byed na nag mo gnod sbyin man chad dang mi byed na bstod pa'i mjug nas sum brdeg lan bcas/ bstab pa la sum brdeg lan bcas kyi mtha' 'gying bcas dang srid zhi ma'i rol tshigs 'theng gsum lnga brdeg gcig 'theng gnyis so// bstod rnying hūm̐ yig ma sogs kyi skabs mgon po'i rnga tshigs dang*/ lha mo'i rnga tshigs rnams sngar dang 'dra/ gdong bzhi pa la bdun brdeg rjes man chad khyed mthun ma bzhin bya/ rjes kyi 'theng rkang 'gying nas/ las mgon gyi dgu brdeg byas ma thag sum brdeg lan bcas bya ste 'di man chad snga ma dang 'dra'o// bstod dbyangs rnams kyi dzar brdeg dang ring thung sogs kyi rnam gzhag bslab sbyangs brtson pa'i shugs kyis rtogs par 'gyur ro// smras pa/ rang rang dgos bya rig pa chung ngu nas// rtun pas ma sbyangs de srid shes bya'i yul// de der mkhas pa'i go sar phyin min pa// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i khyad chos yin// tshul 'dir 'bad pa las byung dge bas bdag /yang srid snyan dngags bstod dbyangs rol mo'i glur// sras bcas rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dren bgyid cing*// 'gro tshogs ma rig gnyid las sgrol gyur cig

/ces bskang gso che chung gi rol tshigs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi zhal shes kyi tho yig dran gso'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhan chen 'jam dpal dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyes spyi bos bsnyen cing rang nyid tshul 'di'i thog ma'i bslab sbyangs la zhugs pa na ji ltar thos pa'i gsung sgros rnams rang gi dran 'dzin dang gsar bu 'gar yang phan par 'gyur srid snyam pa'i sems kyis ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga la bha wa tu// // ༄༅// drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog sogs kyi dmod bcol 'go 'dren sbyor rgyu bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdamod bcol snyan gsan phul zin pa'i skabs der/ ston dang bstan 'dzin gyi che ba brjod par spro na 'di skad do// spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ 'gro 'dul kha lo sgyur ba/ nyag gcig skyabs kyi dam pa/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/ rigs gsum sems dpa' chen po'i zlos gar/ theg gsum bstan pa smra ba'i seng ge 'gro tshogs srid las sgrol ba'i ded dpon/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po zhes yongs su grags pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang*/ thub mchog lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu/ rtsod ldan dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal bstan ring por 'tsho ba'i sman pa/ gsung rab dgongs pa 'grel pa'i nyi ma/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i lugs mchog dri ma med pa de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam par bcas pa rnams dang*/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me/ rigs gsum sems dpa'i sprul pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sa skya pa'i gdung sras kyi phreng ba rim par byon pa rnams dang*/ lung rtogs bstan pa rgyas pa'i rtsa lag

bshad sgrub sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i rnga gsang*/ sbyin pa dag pa'i yon gnas dam pa/ ngur smrig 'chang ba 'dus pa'i chos grwa chen po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i mtshon pa'i chos sde mtha' dag gi phrin las/ mnga' thang*/ dpal 'byor/ grwa rigs/ mi sder bcas pa dang*/ rgyal bstan skyong ba'i rtsa lag dad dang gtong ba'i nor can/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bdag cag sgrub pa po dang bcas pa rnams la/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub mor brtsams shing brtsam par 'gyur ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren/ byad ma'i rigs su gyur pa gang yin pa sogs dkyus dang sbrel lo// zhes pa 'jigs byed drug cu dang mgon po'i gtor bzlog sogs kyi dmod bcol gyi 'go 'dren sbyor rgyu 'di ni/ don gnyer rnams kyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis dngos po zhes pa'i gnam lo'i zla tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
